text: 在浦东新区汇商大厦举行的上海正衡金融消费者权益保护中心揭牌仪式上，金融监管总局金融消费者权益投诉调解中心、上海金融监管局、上海市委金融办、上海市民政局、上海市司法局、上海市市场监管局、中国人民银行上海市分行、上海证监局、浦东新区区委金融办等单位相关负责同志出席，共同见证消保中心揭牌。（上证报）
text_en: At the unveiling ceremony of the Shanghai Zhengheng Financial Consumer Rights Protection Center held at Huishang Building in Pudong New Area, relevant responsible officials from the Financial Consumer Rights Complaint and Mediation Center of the National Financial Regulatory Administration, Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau, Shanghai Municipal Financial Office, Shanghai Civil Affairs Bureau, Shanghai Justice Bureau, Shanghai Market Supervision Administration, People's Bank of China Shanghai Branch, Shanghai Securities Regulatory Bureau, and Pudong New Area District Committee Financial Office attended and jointly witnessed the unveiling of the consumer protection center. (Shanghai Securities News)
